facts.fact: 父亲 hesitated 后低声告知：他和 Eloise 离婚了（两年前，L125）。
facts.anchor: He rubs his chin uncomfortably, looking hesitant. “We got a divorce,” he whispers.

facts.fact: Eloise 在 Billie 生命里的十六年中，说「我爱你」的次数一只手数得过来——爱「像一粒沙」。
facts.anchor: That woman had as much love in her body as a single grain of sand. I could count on both hands the number of times she told me she loved me throughout the sixteen years she was in my life.

facts.fact: 生母背景：Billie 六岁时父亲拿到完全监护权，生母连出庭争夺都没去。
facts.anchor: My dad gained full custody when I was only six-years-old. She didn’t even show up to court to try and fight it, she just let it happen.

facts.fact: 十年不联系的真相：父亲当年站在 Eloise 一边是怕她离开——结果「全白费」。
facts.anchor: He didn’t reach out because he loved Eloise. He thought he was doing the right thing with standing by her. He didn’t want her to leave.

facts.fact: Billie 二十八岁重新开始：她要坦白自己结过婚又离了，这正是回来的原因。
facts.anchor: “Dad—” I take a deep breath as I choke down my tears. Not at the thought of Graham, but picturing the fact that I have to start over again at twenty-eight years old.

facts.fact: Graham 婚变闪回：最后一年的真相是「他很久已经不爱她了」。
facts.anchor: “The last year—” The tears started before I could try to stop them. I took an unsteady breath before continuing, “He hasn’t loved me for a long time.”

facts.fact: Eloise 离婚的导火索：父亲发现她私自在另一家银行藏钱、蓄谋已久。
facts.anchor: I came to eventually find out she was hiding money at a separate bank. She was planning our demise for a long time, scheming, I should say.

facts.fact: 父亲戒酒两年（官宣离婚那天停酒）；离婚分产：房子归他、大部分存款归她。
facts.anchor: I’ve been sober for two years now. I stopped drinking once it was official. I got the house, and she got most of the savings.

facts.fact: 后院白橡树上挂着父亲小时候为她做的秋千，正在开始断落——章末意象。
facts.anchor: The swing that he built for me when I was little, hangs on one of the branches and is starting to break off.
